name: Sigiriya Village
tagline: In the shadow of the Lion Rock
description: The heart of it all, a cluster of guesthouses, small eateries, and shops set among paddy and jungle right by the Sigiriya tank and the base of the rock. You can walk or cycle to the entrance and wake to birdsong and monkeys.
bestFor: Slow travellers who want the rock and paddy on their doorstep
pros: Walking and cycling distance to Sigiriya rock and the tank
Authentic village atmosphere among paddy and jungle
Warm family-run guesthouses and home-cooked meals
cons: Very quiet, with almost nothing to do after dark

name: Kimbissa and the Inamaluwa Road
tagline: Green backroads on the Dambulla approach
description: The rural stretch along the road toward Inamaluwa and the Dambulla junction, dotted with guesthouses, eco-lodges, and paddy views. It trades doorstep proximity to the rock for a little more space, quiet, and easy access to the main highway.
bestFor: Travellers with transport who want calm and value
pros: Quieter and often better value than the village core
Handy for driving toward Dambulla and the highway
cons: You need a bicycle, scooter, or tuktuk to get around
Fewer eateries and services within walking distance

name: Dambulla
tagline: The cave-temple town and transport hub
description: The nearby town about 15 kilometres away, home to the UNESCO golden cave temples and the region's main bus connections toward Kandy, Colombo, and the ancient cities. More amenities, cafes, and steadier connectivity than the village, at the cost of Sigiriya's quiet.
bestFor: Those wanting amenities, transport links, and better wifi
pros: Frequent buses to Kandy, Colombo, and Anuradhapura
More cafes, shops, and generally steadier connectivity
UNESCO cave temples and a big produce market on hand
cons: Busier and less scenic than Sigiriya village
A tuktuk or bus ride from the rock itself

name: Pidurangala and the Habarana Side
description: The northern side around Pidurangala rock, the celebrated sunrise viewpoint facing Lion Rock, extending toward Habarana, the gateway town for Minneriya and Kaudulla elephant safaris. Boutique lodges and jungle stays cluster here amid open scrub and lakes.
bestFor: Sunrise hikers and safari-focused nature lovers
pros: Best sunrise view of Sigiriya from Pidurangala rock
Close to Minneriya and Kaudulla elephant safaris via Habarana
Boutique jungle lodges and open, wild scenery
cons: More spread out, so transport is essential
Pricier boutique options alongside the budget stays
